stem: Which sentence from the selection “DO Look Down!” best explains why the Hualapai wanted to create the Grand Canyon Skywalk?

options.label: A
options.text: Nature lovers from around the world come to see the Grand Canyon. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: They needed an extreme attraction to bring new economic life to their home. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Then one day David Jin, a businessman from Las Vegas, suggested this unique project to the Hualapai tribe members. (paragraph 3)

options.label: D
options.text: After much discussion tribal elders supported the idea to build the skywalk. (paragraph 4)
